{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2014–15 |team=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos |image=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos wordmark.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Big West Conference |division= |short_conf=Big West |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=19–14 |conf_record=11–5 |head_coach=[[Bob Williams (basketball, born 1953)|Bob Williams]] |hc_year = 17th |asst_coach1=Matt Stock |asst_coach2=[[Kevin Bromley]] |asst_coach3=Ryan Madry |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[UC Santa Barbara Events Center|The Thunderdome]] |champion= |bowl= [[2015 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] |bowl_result=first round }} {{2014–15 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gauchos, led by 17th-year head coach [[Bob Williams (basketball, born 1953)|Bob Williams]], played their home games at the [[UC Santa Barbara Events Center]], nicknamed ''The Thunderdome'', as members of the [[Big West Conference]]. They finished the season 19–14, 11–5 in Big West play, to finish in a tie for second place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2015 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]] where they lost to [[2014–15 UC Irvine Anteaters men's basketball team|UC Irvine]]. They were invited to the [[2015 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they lost in the first round to [[2014–15 Oral Roberts Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Oral Roberts]]. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2014|team=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos|teamcolors=y|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Hunter|last=Ford|num=0|pos=G|ft=6|in=3|lbs=180|class=so|rs=y|home=[[Roseville, CA]]|high_school=[[Oakmont High School|Oakmont HS]]|note=W}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Eric|last=Childress|num=1|pos=G|ft=6|in=0|lbs=175|class=so|rs=|home=[[Hawthorne, CA]]|high_school=[[Leuzinger High School|Leuzinger HS]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Gabe|last=Vincent|link=y|num=2|pos=G|ft=6|in=3|lbs=190|class=fr|rs=|home=[[Stockton, CA]]|high_school=[[St. Mary's High School (Stockton, California)|St. Mary's HS]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Zalmico|last=Harmon|num=3|pos=G|ft=6|in=0|lbs=185|class=sr|rs=|home=[[Washington, D.C.]]|high_school=[[Ballou High School|Ballou HS]]
